Context: 1. Admissibility.-

2. Where, however, on death of a re-employed civil Government servant, the family is eligible for special/ extraordinary family pension under the EOP Rules in respect of the first spell of service, family pension for the second spell of service will be admissible under the CCS (Pension) Rules, 1972 only.
3. The extraordinary family pension shall be granted only in one service. In no case, both the family pensions shall be granted under EOP Rules. - GID (16), Rule 50.
